title: Measure a conversion, and the ceiling above it

exports.name: box_iou
exports.signature: box_iou(a: tuple[float, float, float, float], b: tuple[float, float, float, float]) -> float
exports.description: Intersection over union of two axis-aligned boxes given as left, top, right, bottom.

exports.name: match_boxes
exports.signature: match_boxes(predicted: list[dict], truth: list[dict], iou_threshold: float) -> list[tuple[int, int]]
exports.description: Greedily pair predicted boxes with ground-truth boxes of the same label above an overlap threshold.

exports.name: mean_average_precision
exports.signature: mean_average_precision(predicted: list[dict], truth: list[dict], thresholds: list[float]) -> float
exports.description: Average precision averaged over the given overlap thresholds, which is the metric the layout literature reports.

exports.name: pairwise_agreement
exports.description: Agreement across two or more independent annotations of the same page, scored with the same metric a model would be.

exports.name: conversion_coverage
exports.description: Fraction of the page's text that survives into the converted output, which a page that converted into nothing scores zero on.
